conversationalSummary.text: Tomorrow is probably one to skip. Lagide at Evening — 17:00 looks like the least-bad option, but not really something worth chasing. best.explanation: Lagide looks like a fun-sized window for Fun progression, Low confidence: 0.9-1.2 m, 101 kJ, 8 s period, very consistent 80/100, and wind is the main risk.  A dependable left-hand reef that turns modest swell into real rides; this is best for clean, playful walls when the bigger beaches are too wild or too small; 6-9s at high tide is too flat and weak on the reef shelves.  Watch: wind angle is poor for this spot; 6-9s at high tide is too flat and weak on the reef shelves; gusts over 35 km/h could make it messy; SwellMap rating 2/10 Poor — caution.
best.shortExplanation: Lagide is worth a quick check for evening — 17:00, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide makes the reef a bit less forgiving.

ranked.explanation: Cerro looks like a fun-sized window for Worth checking, Low confidence: 0.6-1.1 m, 84 kJ, 8 s period, consistent 79/100, and wind is the main risk.  A sheltered beachbreak with gentle lefts and rights, somewhat similar to Cantinho but less consistent; this is best for manageable bodyboard waves when north-northwest swell reaches the bay with clean southerly wind.  Watch: wind angle is poor for this spot; 6-9s at high tide is usually too fat for exposed beaches like Belgas / Almagreira / Cerro / Meio da Baia; Cerro may feel too soft without more push; gusts over 35 km/h could make it messy.
